system.description: The spell allows the enchanted person to easily see their own footprints on the ground. The tracks light up with a reddish glow that only the enchanted person can see. If they crossed a body of water at some point or traveled in a manner that does not leave tracks (such as jumping over a ravine, swimming, or riding a horse), small pieces of vitner light will collect on the water or in the air to indicate the direction.
system.summary: The spell allows the enchanted person to easily see their own footprints on the ground.

powerLevels.effect: Increase the range by 5 meters (contact is no longer necessary)
Affect an extra being (with the spell’s basic version)
